svg.title: Hackathon implementation architecture
svg.desc: Five-stage pipeline: load and normalize, graph construction, structural comparison, candidate refinement, and output

g.text: Read 5 edge-list CSVs · deduplicate · build adjacency sets · compute degree sequences per node
Build NetworkX DiGraphs · compute in/out-degree histogram · extract degree signature per node
VF2 / backtracking search (networkx.is_isomorphic) on candidate pairs
Grow seed matches greedily: add one node at a time while preserving isomorphism
Keep the largest valid matching across ≥3 datasets simultaneously
Write CSV (3 dataset columns × N neuron rows) · verify induced subgraph identity · confirm directionality
FlyWire Codex metadata · cell type / neurotransmitter lookup · literature · network viz · 3D mesh

svg.text: • Ignore edge weights — treat all edges as unweighted directed edges
• Circuit = directed induced subgraph (all edges between selected nodes must match)
• Need ≥3 of 5 datasets (choose the triple that yields the largest N)
• BANC/FAFB use 18-digit IDs; MANC/MAOL/MCNS use short integers — no cross-ID matching
• Datasets are 100MB+ each → use chunked loading, avoid loading full matrices in RAM
• Maximize N (number of matched neurons) — the score is circuit size
